articles.title: • After a layoff and divorce, I built an app studio at my kitchen table
articles.excerpt: I’m sharing this today not to look back at what I lost, but to celebrate what love and resilience can build when you refuse to give up. Twelve months ago, my life was completely reset. I lost my job i…
articles.body: I’m sharing this today not to look back at what I lost, but to celebrate what love and resilience can build when you refuse to give up. Twelve months ago, my life was completely reset. I lost my job in a layoff, and shortly after, my marriage ended. Suddenly, I was raising my 2-year-old on my own with a tight budget. There were plenty of days when I skipped meals just to make sure my kid had everything they needed. In those quiet moments at the kitchen table, watching my toddler smile without a care in the world, something shifted inside me. Instead of feeling defeated, I felt an overwhelming surge of purpose. That little kid gave me a superpower I didn't know I had.
articles.author: shivaya

articles.title: How to Migrate From Webflow to Shopify Without Losing SEO
articles.excerpt: Moving platforms changes every URL, template, and tag on your site. Here's the process I use so the rankings you've already earned come with you. Most SEO losses after a migration aren't caused by the…
articles.body: Moving platforms changes every URL, template, and tag on your site. Here's the process I use so the rankings you've already earned come with you. Most SEO losses after a migration aren't caused by the new platform. Shopify is perfectly capable of ranking. They're caused by three avoidable things: old URLs that lead nowhere, titles and content that quietly change in transit, and nobody checking the results after launch. The principle behind everything below is simple. Search engines need to find every important old page, land on its closest new equivalent, and find the same content and signals when they arrive. A migration that does that keeps most of what it had. One that doesn't spends months recovering.
articles.author: Webko Digital

articles.title: Why my inbox triage tool refuses to ask for your Gmail password
articles.excerpt: The first question I get about EmailTriage is why it doesn't connect to Gmail. I could have built an OAuth flow, requested read access, and synced messages in the background. I didn't, and the reason…
articles.body: The first question I get about EmailTriage is why it doesn't connect to Gmail. I could have built an OAuth flow, requested read access, and synced messages in the background. I didn't, and the reason isn't privacy theater. It's that the connection is the expensive part of the problem, and most of what people need from triage doesn't require it. Triage is a classification task over a finite batch. You have a pile of messages, you want to know which ones need a reply today, which ones you can read later, and which ones are noise. That's a labeling problem, not a synchronization problem. Once I framed it that way, the architecture got small.
articles.author: LXSAIHUB

That changed with Swift 6.3, which shipped the first official Swift SDK for Android. You can now compile Swift code for Android devices using official tools published on swift.org, instead of relying on unofficial community toolchains. articles.title: Unified CLI Framework Reduces Development Boilerplate and Integrates Autocomplete
articles.excerpt: Traditional command-line interface development operates as a fractured distributed system disguised as a single binary. When building a CLI using legacy toolchains, a developer is forced to maintain t…
articles.body: The Fragmentation Crisis in Modern CLI Development Traditional command-line interface development operates as a fractured distributed system disguised as a single binary. When building a CLI using legacy toolchains, a developer is forced to maintain three distinct, decoupled artifacts for every single command, flag, and argument: the core execution logic, the static documentation (typically written in archaic roff for manpages or markdown for tldr ), and the interactive shell completion scripts for bash , zsh , and fish . This multi-file architecture imposes a heavy synchronization tax. When a flag's default value or type changes in the implementation code, that modification does not automatically propagate to the completion script or the manual page.
articles.author: Viktor Logvinov

articles.title: How Do You Make a Bama Bound AI Clip Loop Without a Visible Jump? A Tail-to-Head Crossfade in ffmpeg, With a Seam Score
articles.excerpt: Checked November 11, 2026. I build bamabound.app, which turns one photo of one person into a vertical clip of them holding a red I'M BAMA BOUND banner. The test clip in this post is synthetic (a red b…
articles.body: Checked November 11, 2026. I build bamabound.app , which turns one photo of one person into a vertical clip of them holding a red I'M BAMA BOUND banner. The test clip in this post is synthetic (a red box swaying over a green field, with beeps), not a real person. People ask some version of this a lot: "How do I make my Bama Bound video loop smoothly on my story / on a website / on a screen at a grad party?" Players already repeat short videos. The problem is the moment where they do. A Bama Bound clip follows the reference timing of about eight seconds in a 9:16 frame, with the original soundtrack attached ( FAQ ). The last frame and the first frame were never meant to meet, so every repeat has a visible jump: the banner snaps from one side to the other, and the audio clicks.

articles.title: Японское ударение в одной цифре: генерируем рисунок тона из словарной записи
articles.excerpt: Японское ударение в одной цифре: генерируем рисунок тона из словарной записи Если вы делаете карточки для Anki, словарь или тренажёр японского, рано или поздно захочется показывать ударение. В японско…
articles.body: Японское ударение в одной цифре: генерируем рисунок тона из словарной записи Если вы делаете карточки для Anki, словарь или тренажёр японского, рано или поздно захочется показывать ударение. В японском оно тональное: слоги различаются не громкостью, а высотой — высоко (H) или низко (L). Хорошая новость для разработчика: хранить для каждого слова таблицу H/L не нужно. В словарях ударение записывают одним числом, а рисунок из него восстанавливается в несколько строк кода. Что означает число Число — это номер моры, после которой тон падает: 0 — хэйбан: тон поднимается после первой моры и не падает, даже на частице после слова; 1 — атамадака: высокая только первая мора; от 2 до n−1 — накадака: тон падает внутри слова; n — одака (n — число мор): тон высокий до конца слова и падает на частице.

articles.excerpt: We hooked up with Mackie, DeBose, and Lequizamo to learn more about this renaissance of audio dramas and what attracted them to board Weir's sci-fi thriller.
articles.body: In any respectable audiobook project, finding the names of Andy Weir ("The Martian," "Project Hail Mary") and Benjamin Percy ("The Ninth Metal," "Wolverine") attached would elicit intense fan interest, but add the superstar vocal talents of Anthony Mackie ("Avengers: Infinity War," "Avengers: Doomsday"), Ariana DeBose ("West Side Story"), and John Leguizamo ("Ice Age"), and it catapults this sonic odyssey into the stratosphere. Such is the case with " Exoplanet ," Audible Original’s new 7-episode science fiction audio drama executive produced by Weir and penned by Percy. Its planet-hopping space disaster narrative sees the crew of the starship Wild Blue Yonder hit a quantum anomaly, forcing their ship to crash-land onto a deadly exoplanet.

articles.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
articles.excerpt: Microsoft did another four-digit patch drop today, releasing updates to fix almost 1,100 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software. This month's Patch Tuesday ad…
articles.body: Microsoft did another four-digit patch drop today, releasing updates to fix almost 1,100 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software. This month’s Patch Tuesday addresses 63 critical flaws — including a zero-day in Microsoft Outlook — and comes amid important security updates from other software makers, including Adobe , Apple , Google and Mozilla . Image: Shutterstock.com. Diorama by @zepp1969. November’s patch release from Redmond tackles 1,093 vulnerabilities, fixing 63 “critical” flaws that can be exploited to seize control over a Windows system with little or no help from users. Nearly half of those critical bugs are remote code execution vulnerabilities.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 10, 2013: Europe's GOCE satellite, the 'Ferrari of space,' fell out of orbit after mapping Earth's gravity field
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 10, 2013, Europe's GOCE satellite fell to Earth after four years in orbit mapping the planet's gravitational field. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 10, 2013, Europe's GOCE satellite fell to Earth after four years in orbit mapping the planet's gravitational field. GOCE, its name was short for Gravity field and steady-state Ocean Circulation Explorer, launched in 2009 on a mission to map Earth's gravity like never before. But despite that successful mission, it was doomed in 2013 when it ran out of fuel . At the time, controllers weren't sure where GOCE would fall back to Earth . Some people worried that it might crash into a populated area. However, the small spacecraft broke up in the atmosphere and didn't cause any property damage. It disintegrated about 50 miles above the Falkland Islands in the South Atlantic Ocean. The European Space Agency called the mission a success. GOCE lasted far longer than expected.

articles.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
articles.excerpt: Researcher finds 35,000 Grok Build apps wide open to anyone who looked for them.
articles.body: Grok Build, the vibe-coding agent from SpaceXSI, is leaking data—some of it proprietary business information and other sensitive secrets—from thousands of its users, including the very same Elon Musk-owned company that offers the platform, new research shows. The information is revealed through links allowing Grok Build users to share their apps with others. Grok takes steps to randomize the URLs so only people who know the exact URL can access the data stored there. A design decision by developers of the platform, however, completely torpedoes that objective and makes it possible for anyone to enumerate thousands of live Grok Build projects. Except in rare cases, clicking those links opens the app and reveals all data associated with it.
